content: Expo SDK 52+ auto-detects monorepos via expo/metro-config — no manual watchFolders needed. For pnpm, set node-linker=hoisted in .npmrc for simplest Metro compat. Alternatively use config.resolver.unstable_enableSymlinks=true plus adding node_modules/.pnpm to watchFolders. SDK 52+ adds experiments.onDemandFilesystem (default on) for global virtual store support. Singleton pinning required: React, React Native, Expo must resolve to single instances — set resolver.nodeModulesPaths to include root node_modules. If unstable_enablePackageExports needed, set that flag too.
